text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Mesin Cetak dan Penerbitan

(Kawalan Hasil Penerbitan Tidak Diingini) (No. 14) 2016.

Larangan

2. Pencetakan, pengimportan, penghasilan, penghasilan semula, penerbitan,

penjualan, pengeluaran, pengelilingan, pengedaran atau pemilikan hasil penerbitan

yang diperihalkan dalam Jadual yang mungkin memudaratkan ketenteraman awam,

yang mungkin menggemparkan fikiran orang ramai, yang mungkin memudaratkan

kemoralan dan yang mungkin memudaratkan kepentingan negara adalah dilarang

secara mutlak di seluruh Malaysia.

PRINTING PRESSES AND PUBLICATIONS ACT 1984

PRINTING PRESSES AND PUBLICATIONS

(CONTROL OF UNDESIRABLE PUBLICATIONS) (NO. 14) ORDER 2016

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 7(1) of the

Printing Presses and Publications Act 1984 [Act 301], the Minister makes the following

order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Printing Presses and Publications (Control of

Undesirable Publications) (No. 14) Order 2016.

Prohibition

2. The printing, importation, production, reproduction, publishing, sale, issue,

circulation, distribution or possession of the publication described in the Schedule

which is likely to be prejudicial to public order, likely to alarm public opinion, likely to

be prejudicial to morality and likely to be prejudicial to national interest are absolutely

prohibited throughout Malaysia.
